facts_of_case: Wife-petitioner seeking transfer of divorce proceeding from Family Court, Sambalpur to Family Court, Cuttack due to financial constraints and safety concerns.

legal_principles.principle: A court may transfer a case to another court if it is difficult for the parties to attend proceedings in the original court.
legal_principles.held: Considering the submission made and looking to the financial status of the wife-petitioner and since wife does not feel safe to attend the proceeding at Sambalpur, which is almost 280 kms away from Cuttack, this Court observes, there would be no difficulty, if the case of the husband gets transferred to the Family Court, Cuttack.

legal_principles.principle: A court may direct the transmission of case records to another court for disposal.
legal_principles.held: This Court also directs learned Judge, Family Court, Cuttack to dispose of the C.P. No.44 of 2020 as expeditiously as possible preferably within a period of six months from the date of transmission of the case records.

outcome.final_order: Case transferred to Family Court, Cuttack; husband-opposite party directed to appear voluntarily; case to be disposed of expeditiously within six months.
